english.title: Air weapon - possession with intent to cause fear of violence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) had in your possession a firearm namely a **(..SPECIFY THE MAKE, TYPE AND CALIBRE..) air weapon, with intent

(A)_[by means thereof]_
(B)_[to enable **(..SPECIFY THIRD PERSON..), by means thereof]_

to cause **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to believe that unlawful violence would be used against

(C)_[him]_
(D)_[her]_

or another
english.legislation: Contrary to section 16A of, and Schedule 6 to, the Firearms Act 1968.

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Expert evidence must be obtained to prove that the air weapon was a firearm within the terms of section 57 of the Firearms Act 1968. If the air weapon does not fall within section 57 no offence is committed under this subsection.
(ii) See also offence wordings: H1215; H1162 and H1163.
(iii) On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shotgun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).
(iv) This offence is a specified violent offence under section 306 of the Sentencing Act 2020, see Part 1 of Schedule 18 to that Act; this is, for example, relevant for certain extended sentences of detention or imprisonment.
(v) See also Home Office Guidance on Firearms Licensing Law.
